Respondents** # ** Corrigendum ** The Commission vide order dated 04.10.2016 in Petition No. 254/GT/2014 had revised the tariff of the generating station for the period 2009-14 after truing up exercise in terms of Regulation 6 (1) of 2009 Tariff Regulations. 2.
